The Booker Prize longlist is a celebration of the very best contemporary fiction, bringing together powerful stories from some of the world's most talented writers. Since 2021, the award has recognised a diverse range of novels, from established literary figures to debut authors making their mark.

Explore past Booker Prize nominees and winners, including critically acclaimed novels such as The Promise by Damon Galgut, The Seven Moons of Maali Almeida by Shehan Karunatilaka, Prophet Song by Paul Lynch and Orbital by Samantha Harvey. Discover thought-provoking fiction from authors including Kazuo Ishiguro, Claire Keegan, Percival Everett and Rachel Kushner, alongside emerging voices and international perspectives.

Whether you're building a reading list of award-winning books, searching for the best literary fiction, or discovering previous Booker Prize winners, our collection brings together the novels that have defined one of the world's most respected literary prizes.
